risks.title: Egg prices
risks.summary: Egg prices can fluctuate based on supply and demand, which may affect the company's sales and profits.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to significant fluctuations in egg prices. Average prices have varied substantially (2,622 $ in 2023, 1,932 $ in 2024, 3,134 $ in 2025), directly impacting sales and profits. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: HPAI (Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza)
risks.summary: HPAI can have a significant impact on the company's production and sales, as well as on egg prices.
risks.score_rationale: The resurgence of HPAI in 2023 led to higher egg prices, but also losses for the company due to hen mortality. This could recur in the future. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Input costs
risks.summary: Input costs can vary, which may affect the company's production costs.
risks.score_rationale: Feed costs for hens vary based on weather conditions and commodity market fluctuations. Costs decreased from 0,676 $ per dozen in 2023 to 0,490 $ in 2025, but could rise again. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Competition
risks.summary: Competition may be intense in the egg market, which could affect the company's sales and market share.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, with numerous other egg producers. This could affect the company's sales and market share. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cage-free regulations and compliance
risks.summary: Government regulations regarding animal welfare and cage-free requirements may affect the company's costs and operations.
risks.score_rationale: Ten states have adopted minimum space or cage-free requirements. The DOJ lawsuit in July 2025 against California over cage-free laws adds regulatory uncertainty. Compliance requires significant capital investments (248.4 M $ in approved projects). (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation
risks.summary: Litigation may impact the company's costs and reputation.
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in litigation, including legal proceedings related to competition issues. This could affect the company's costs and reputation. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Weather dependency and production conditions
risks.summary: Weather conditions may affect the company's production and sales.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to weather conditions, which may affect production, flock health, and sales. This could impact costs and profits. (default score, to be refined)
